notes.title: August Build! New level 5, plus the cutscene that follows!
notes.content:
Howdy y'all! I'm a few weeks late, but getting the Aberration Cutscene that plays at the end of level 5 took a longgg time. Huge sprites, but it's all scripted out and plays! It's about 90% done, just needs some art from my artist to really punch it up and finish it out.

Tip - [b]You are going to want a controller for Level 5. I made it fair, but challenging.[/b]

In short - Level 5 was completely redone. New cutscene added that plays at the end. Tweaked the Issac boss fight on level 3. Lots of small bug fixes.


NEXT - I need to polish what I have before I get to the last level. There are a few bugs, lines of dialog, and animations I need to add, for sure. Tile edges can be seen at times, and I need to fix that.

Thanks for reading! As always, you can find me in the Discord. (dances)

~Summer

PS - Remember, if you don't have the 2nd and 3rd save slot when you load the game, you need to delete the old files and reload the game. Navigate to -

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Mercenary Leto\Mercenary Leto_Data\StreamingAssets

And delete SaveFile_1.txt, SaveFile_2.txt, and SaveFile_3.txt

notes.title: July Update - Save Slots are HERE!
notes.content:
Howdy! Sticking to my monthly releases, though this is a few days late, aha~ (sweats)

[u]This months work was definitely foundational[/u] - if you've played the game recently, there is no new content. Maybe some art for a cutscene was added, but that's about it.

[b]THE BIG NEWS IS SAVE SLOTS![/b]

[b]First - every new build will wipe your save[/b]. I have to do that because if I add new save flags to new builds, you will have awful, terrible, no good bugs. And I don't want that, so I wipe the saves.

[b]BUT![/b] I did add two debug saves in the 2nd and 3rd slot for you to "warp" around to later parts of the game. Seen the first two levels enough? Warp to level 3. It's like renting a SNES cartridge from Blockbuster; you never know what you'll end up with!


Anyway, the rest of the list....

[list]
[*] Title screen was overhauled Use the keyboard/xbox controller to select around!
[*] As part of save slots, I updated my save system from Easy Save 2 to Easy Save 3.
[*] I moved to a stable build of Unity - 2021 LTS.
[*] I pulled out an old camera package to use a better one!
[/list]

NEXT - Redo Issac's ship. Get some content in. Tile edges can be seen at times, and I need to fix that.

Thanks for reading! As always, you can find me in the Discord. (dances)

~Summer

PS - if the 2nd/3rd save slot doesn't load, navigate to -

[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Mercenary Leto\Mercenary Leto_Data\StreamingAssets[/i]

And delete SaveFile_1.txt, SaveFile_2.txt, and SaveFile_3.txt,

notes.title: End of May Update!
notes.content:
Howdy y'all, got another update for you!

[b]Content[/b]
The Issac boss fight got a TON of work. He's much better behaved.
Lurkers in the lava level are also more behaved, as they got tons of AI work.
Tailure Dysaur and Kaiden bosses were nerfed.
The 3rd level got lots of work - added plants, added more level, more secrets, and tweaked it overall!
Some cutscenes had some dialog reworked to make it flow better

Debug-Chan can be accessed with an Xbox controller -> Both Triggers + B Button. She'll warp you to the lava level, or anywhere else in the game! Try it out! I also made sure she will only run if you are out of dialog and not on the world map. She could crash the game otherwise, aha....

The Lava Level Rings got messed with! You can drop down from them whenever you wish, and make sounds when you connect/disconnect to them!

Added cutscene art when you get your boots from Xer AND when you feed Alma carrots with Tabs/Lily! It's super cute and you should go watch them sometime!

Added loading screens for when Issac gets onboard the John Mule

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Getting your first seedling would leave the dialog button up. That was fixed.
Companions helping you when you are stunlocked works MUCH better. Also added sounds!
Naked Gilbert stunlock frames were added
Gilberts bullets bounce better now
Grey Clouds in the background on John Mule look much better
You can use the gashapon machine before you go down to the lava level
There is a 3rd seedling on John Mule.
The damage font was changed so it reads better
You can die while holding onto a ring and you'll respawn correctly

[b]Next Steps[/b]
That's it for now! I think next build will be QoL stuff - saving the game, for one! And a Unity upgrade! Wish me luck, I'll cya within a month!

~Summer

notes.title: MAJOR Fall Update, 2021!
notes.content:
We've been busy for 5 months - and we have a TON to show for it! The new build covers Level 1 and 2, which is about 40 minutes of gameplay. This is the new bar we'll be hitting for the rest of the game.

====================

Leto had a ton of work done to her. She has a new movement. She has a charge shot.
Leto's dash goes low now. Leto's animator was redone, and she has a new set of animations for idle, running, and jumping. Letos gun has a kickback, muzzle flash, and dropped bullet shells on all animations. Leto creates dust when she moves, jumps, and lands. Seriously, we put a ton of work into our girl!

Level 1 was completely redone - new enemies (bats and arc toads) - Dysaur riding was also greatly improved! Grass was added and it moves!

John Mule got new backdrops and artwork - Gilbert has bookshelves and a cat tree, Melody and Kiki have bigger stalls, Leto is now a plant mom, and there are two pictures you can find on the ship! John mule has a cockpit! There is new art EVERYWHERE!

Melody has a new system for gashapons - a way to discover new lore in the game!

Level 2 - Caves were redone as well, with moving mushrooms! Jellycats got animation frames! Boss got another art/code pass, too! Tabris' animations were all redone! 

Also - you can no longer get stuck on tail-lures, or the boss!

# Other things

[list]
[*] Title screen was touched up
[*] Loading Screen has custom art and quips for lore
[*] When a level starts, it flashes 'Contract Start!'
[*] There is a game over screen now!
[*] Changed the buttons around a bit! But, you can remap your keyboard controls! And change your screen resolutions!
[*] Dialog UI was touched up, now has a cute Alma prompt for continuing dialog! It also can move around the screen, which will be used in a few cutscenes for comedic effect!
[*] Started adding dialog bits to punch up the 'Mercenary' in Mercenary Leto - Tabs mentions he's a merc more, Leto and Pax have dialog to help with that, Kiki mentions 'contracts'
[*] Monsters drop health or dust now - new full-health drop!
[*] Fixed the FMV flashing bug - where you'd see the level again right before the level would reload
[*] Companions will land on the ground if you get into dialog
[*] Can skip cutscenes at full speed, even if there is movement in the scripting
[*] The FMV for when Tabs/Lily gets introduced was touched up
[/list]

We'll be starting on Level 3 now - we already have new art assets and a basic level started. Talk again soon!

Y'all at the best,
~Summer

notes.title: Let's Play 2019 COMPLETE - New build out!

[b]THE BIG THING [/b]- I took the dialog gate out after the Issac boss fight. You can see content - though it gets rougher instantly - [b]after that fight.[/b] [i]This is a sneak peek at the future of the game.[/i] I hope you enjoy.

I took this out as a fun way for players to see behind the scenes of how I work as a person. I stub it out first via writing, then begin to build more from there - art, mechanics, etc.... when you are done seeing it or don't know how to continue, hit the escape key to leave the game.
